diagnostics.description: Macro over canonical-song groups, independent annotated beats, one-to-one mir_eval default70ms matching and first5s trimmed. diagnostics.name: Annotated beat continuity CMLt
diagnostics.description: mir_eval CMLt with the same independently annotated songs, exclusions and trimming as layers-annotated-beat-f1-70ms. Report half/double tempo diagnostics and annotation ambiguity separately.

diagnostics.name: Chromatic-only event average precision
diagnostics.description: Macro-song event AP from ranked local maxima with >=.2s suppression; one-to-one matching to frozen chromatic-only events within±.2s, tied confidence groups handled together. Referenceevents from jointHS pre/post windows, never V/p90. TRAIN-only label thresholds, cut/dark/achromatic/mask eligibility frozen. Nonevent songs retained in falsecue-rate/coverage, not fabricated AP. Common truth across everyrepresentationarm; report prevalence and shift/history/beat/coverageonly baselines.

diagnostics.name: Authored-video intensity-accent event average precision
diagnostics.description: Same event-level matching/aggregation as layers-color-event-ap but independent normalized intensity-rise visual events at native target resolution, tolerance±.2s. These are authored-video light proxies, not70ms acousticbeat annotations. Compare beat-only, eventhistory, onset/spectral baselines and circular shifts.

diagnostics.name: Palette state temporal distribution error
diagnostics.description: Mean1D Wasserstein across fixed palette-state transition summaries: log residence durations, conditional mark-change distance, inter-transition drift, long-lag change. Component scales fit onTRAINonly; components and diversity separatelyreported. Same vocabulary, cue times, draws and output intensity for independent-held vs persistent comparison. Constant palette must fail diversity gate. GAME-proxy distribution fidelity, not aestheticquality.

diagnostics.name: Palette marginal distribution error

diagnostics.name: Background chromatic extraction error under independently known masks
diagnostics.description: Mean Jensen-Shannon distance of extracted jointHS distribution to independent retained-background reference on prespecified auditedframes/known-backgroundcomposites. Color validity identical; frames/canonicalvideos equallyweighted. Existingboxmask comparator. Syntheticcontrols alone limitclaimtosynthetic recovery; no self-scoring againstSAMderivedtruth.

diagnostics.name: Human foreground mask IoU
diagnostics.description: Pixel IoU against independent audited human masks on prespecified sourceframes. Box and SAM2 prompts share sameoriginalcoordinate space. No modelgeneratedmask as groundtruth; source annotationprovenance required.

diagnostics.name: Repeated-section palette relation error
diagnostics.description: Absolute error in pairwise jointHS palette distances for independently audio-derived repeated-section pairs versus matchednonrepeat pairs; compare common-reference relationships, not simplyreward identical colors. Same cue times/vocabulary/variationbudget; compare no-memory and shuffledrepeatIDs. TRAIN-scaled and macro-song aggregated.

diagnostics.name: False cues on nonevent valid regions
diagnostics.description: Count emitted events unmatched to reference within registeredtolerance per eligibleminute, including nonevent songs. Separate color and accent channels in report; primarypairedscorecannotdropquiettracks.
